name: @plainphone/api-client
description: Types generated from server/openapi.yaml and a small typed fetch wrapper

scripts.check: mkdir -p node_modules/.cache && openapi-typescript ../../server/openapi.yaml -o node_modules/.cache/schema.d.ts && diff -u src/schema.d.ts node_modules/.cache/schema.d.ts && echo 'src/schema.d.ts matches server/openapi.yaml'
